items.quote: If and when AGI is invented, the novel’s warning will become life-and-death relevant.

source.note: Tweet text and date (2024-04-17T07:33:49Z, @DavidDeutschOxf) confirmed via X's public syndication endpoint and Anders's screenshot. It is a quote-tweet of Matt Bateman. Quote begins mid-sentence ("And indeed, if and when…"); "If" capitalised by decision.

quotes: Have you ever read something so good that you had to stop reading it?
I had to go walk the chapter off. Seriously.

items.text: Victor Frankenstein’s mistake feels remarkably modern… Maybe Frankenstein has something to tell us about the race to build AGI.
